messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Review a bounded feasibility claim about public Hive Engine sidechain records; do not choose accounting policy, valuation method, provider, budget, or deployment. Official source facts: (1) JsonRPCServer getTransactionInfo(txid) finds the indexed transaction and returns its blockNumber plus the complete transaction from block.transactions[index]. (2) Transaction persists sender, contract, action, payload, executedCodeHash, hash, databaseHash, and JSON-string logs. (3) nested smart-contract events are copied into the outer transaction logs. (4) market matching transfers the traded token from contract market to buyer and SWAP.HIVE from contract market to seller, then inserts a tradesHistory row containing type,buyer,seller,symbol,quantity,price,volume,buyTxId,sellTxId, but does not emit that row. (5) tradesHistory deletes symbol rows older than 24 hours whenever a new trade for that symbol is inserted. (6) two independent public RPCs returned byte-equivalent semantic results for known tx 9a0e...: marketSell CENT 0.001 by michael561; logs transferToContract michael561->market CENT 0.00100000, transferFromContract market->d1connect CENT 0.00100000, transferFromContract market->michael561 SWAP.HIVE 0.00000107. The passive maker order tx e168... is separately permanent but logs only its original SWAP.HIVE lock. Evaluate only: whether one execution transaction log can reconstruct executed fill quantities and effective price; whether it can always reconstruct the exact tradesHistory row and maker order tx id; whether multi-fill logs are unambiguously pairable from event order; what additional permanent evidence or deterministic replay is required; and the smallest bounded tests needed before relying on this as historical price evidence. Treat absence as unknown, never zero.
